newsitem.title: UK: UK machine tools turnover -6.1% 3m to April.
newsitem.headline: UK machine tools turnover -6.1% 3m to April.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics (ONS) said turnover in machine tools fell a seasonally adjusted 6.1 percent in the three months to April 1997 compared with the previous three months.
This was due to a 10 percent fall in home turnover more than offsetting a 0.2 percent increase in export turnover.
Total turnover was down 3.0 percent compared to the same period a year earlier.
Total orders on hand for machine tools were down 12.8 percent at the end of April compared with the end of January but was down 20 percent on April 1996.
